findings.title: Docs leave out the new "moving" refusal for Change folder…
findings.body: This push moves `busy: busyNow` into `activeTransactionDeps()` (`main/workspaces/index.ts:347`). `relocateRefusal` (`relocate.ts:24-25`) now also turns away "Change folder…" while a group move runs (`busyNow` returns "moving", `index.ts:67`), and `relocateMoving` gives the reason. This backlog paragraph still lists only "while a recording or export runs". So does the `workspaces:relocate` row in the spec (`specs/2026-10-29-several-workspaces-design.md:1302`). Suggest changing both to "while a recording, an export or a move runs".

thread_replies.reply: Confirmed: the catch at index.ts:215-217 now returns `refuseAll(refusalOfError(error))` and no longer reports every error as "stale".
Confirmed: index.ts:174-177 sets `deviceId = null` when `loadDeviceId` rejects and rethrows, so the next group move tries again.
Confirmed: the `skipped` doc (shared/types/workspaces.ts:252-255) now says only Stop fills it, and that a group refused as a whole goes in `failed`. That matches `refuseAll`.
Confirmed: `chipLabel`, `newWorkspace` and `reason_stale` in es.json now say "espacio de trabajo".

structuredOutput.summary: The push puts the shared lock in `activeTransactionDeps()`, so \"Change folder…\" is now also refused while a group move runs. The new `moving` reason is added to `WorkspaceRelocateRefusal` and shown with its own message in English and Spanish. The relocate copy now has a fallback message for unknown reasons, and the not-a-workspace message points to \"Move to\". I found no defects in the code. One docs nit: the backlog doc and the spec still say Change folder… is refused only during a recording or export, and don't mention a move. The spec's channel table was reformatted without dropping any rows. All four earlier threads on these files are fixed.
